indications_and_usage: Uses* Temporarily relieves: ■ common pain or itching from swimmer’s ear ■ clogged ears ■ ear pain or itching from other earaches, after diagnosis by a physician
warnings: Warnings Keep away from eyes. Do not use if you have ear tubes, damaged ear drums or after ear surgery. Stop use and ask a doctor if: ■ symptoms persist for more than 48 hours or worsen. ■ any discharge from ear is present. ■ symptoms are accompanied by a fever. If pregnant or breastfeeding, ask a health professional before use. Keep out of reach of children.
